comment: Seeing yourself go from feeling confident to picking apart every little flaw after scrolling is a really rough shift. Social media can quietly change the standard your brain uses for what is "normal" because you're comparing yourself to edited moments, angles, and people who are literally curating a persona. Maybe the goal isn't getting your old face back, but getting your old way of seeing yourself back.
